questions.question: A writer and critic chat until the critic says APPROVE. What's the risk?
options: The critic may never say APPROVE, so the conversation never ends unless something else stops it
questions.explanation: Conversations have no natural end. Pair the success condition with a budget.

questions.question: What does TextMention('APPROVE') | MaxMessages(10) do?
options: Stops when either APPROVE is said or 10 messages are reached
Stops after APPROVE is said 10 times
questions.explanation: | is OR: success or budget, whichever comes first.

questions.question: How does the critic see the writer's messages?
questions.explanation: Each agent's own messages are 'assistant'; everyone else's arrive as 'user' messages labelled with the speaker.

questions.question: The selector model replies 'maybe planner or fx'. What happens?
options: The reply is rejected because it doesn't name exactly one eligible agent, and the selector is asked again
questions.explanation: Ambiguous picks are retried (up to max_selector_attempts, default 3), which costs extra model calls.

questions.question: By default, what does an AutoGen AssistantAgent return after calling a tool?
options: A prose summary from a second model call
The tool result itself as its message, without another model call
questions.explanation: reflect_on_tool_use is off by default. Turn it on when other agents or humans need a readable summary.

questions.question: You know the next speaker follows a fixed rule (fares after planner, fx after fares). What should you use?
options: A selector_func (code) or round-robin, saving a model call per turn
questions.explanation: Don't pay a model to make a decision code can make.
